'''Free Fire World Series - Global Finals 2025''' is the final event of the 2025 competitive season, held in {{FlagNoLink|id}} Jakarta, Indonesia<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DFUJo7SpfGP/ |title=🔥 We’re excited to unveil the 2025 roadmap! |publisher='''Garena Free Fire Esports''' |author=Garena |date=2025-01-27}}</ref>.

The overall event featured 618,778 participants, setting a new Guinness World Record for the Largest Mobile Team-Based Esports Tournament.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DRGiPGtElfv/|title=Guiness &#91;sic&#93; World Record for the Largest Mobile Team - Based Esports Tournament!|publisher=Free Fire Esports Indonesia|date=2025-11-15}}</ref><!-- Replace with Guinness World Records source when available -->

==About==
===Format===
* '''Knockout Stage:''''' October 31st - November 9th, 2025
** 18 teams, divided into 3 groups of 6.
** Each week consists of 3 matchdays.
** 36 matches across 6 matchdays, each team play total 24 matches.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|'''Top 8 teams after Week 1 (3 matchdays)'''}} advance to '''[[{{PAGENAME}}/Clash_Squad|Clash Squad Mode]]'''.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 12 teams}} advance to ''Grand Finals''.
<div style="margin-top:1em"></div>
* '''Grand Finals:''''' November 15th, 2025 at the Indonesia Arena, {{FlagNoLink|id}} Jakarta<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DO5sOLbE-D5/ |title=The biggest stage awaits! |publisher='''Garena Free Fire Esports''' |author=Garena |date=2025-09-22}}</ref>
** 12 teams.
** '''Champion Rush''' format is applied. {{ChampionRush|maxmatch=10}}
<br/>
{{Points12|showtb=true}}

==Format==
* '''FFWS Global Finals 2025 - Knockout Stage:''''' October 31st - November 9th, 2025
** 18 teams, divided into 3 groups of 6.
** Each week consists of 3 matchdays.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|'''Top 8 teams after Week 1'''}} advance to '''[[Free_Fire_World_Series/2025/Clash_Squad|Clash Squad Mode]]'''.
** 36 matches across 6 matchdays, each team play total 24 matches.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 12 teams}} advance to ''Grand Finals''.

'''Free Fire World Series - Global Finals 2025''' is the final event of the 2025 competitive season, held in {{FlagNoLink|id}} Jakarta, Indonesia<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DFUJo7SpfGP/ |title=🔥 We’re excited to unveil the 2025 roadmap! |publisher='''Garena Free Fire Esports''' |author=Garena |date=2025-01-27}}</ref>.

The 2025 edition marks the first time the global series hosts an official '''4v4 Clash Squad''' tournament.

==About==
===Format===
* '''Swiss Stage:''''' November 5th - 6th, 2025
** {{Bgcolortext|stayup|Top 8 teams}} from [[{{BASEPAGENAME}}|Battle Royale - Knockout Week 1]]
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 4 teams (Wins the 1-0 and 1-1 series)}} advance to ''Semi & Grand Finals''.
** {{Bgcolortext|down|Bottom 4 teams (Loses to 0-1 series)}} are ''eliminated''.
<div style="margin-top:1em"></div>
* '''Semi & Grand Finals:''''' November 14th, 2025
** 4 teams.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.

==Format==
* '''FFWS GF 2025 - CS Swiss Stage:''''' November 5th - 6th, 2025
** {{Bgcolortext|stayup|Top 8 teams}} from [[{{BASEPAGENAME}}|Battle Royale - Knockout Week 1]]
** 3 rounds of Swiss Format
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|'''Teams that reach 2 wins in swiss (Wins the 2-0 and 2-1 matchups)'''}} advance to '''Semi & Grand Finals'''.
** {{Bgcolortext|down|'''Teams that reach 2 loss in swiss (Loses to the 0-2 and 1-2 matchups)'''}} will be '''eliminated'''.
